title: The Pair That Went Missing
subject: DSA
briefing: A cargo manifest stores item weights in an array. The scanner should find two distinct positions whose weights add up to the requested capacity.
symptom: Some valid pairs, especially those involving the final item, are reported as missing.
hints: Compare the successful case with one where the second matching value is near the end.
Follow the inner loop's j value. Which array positions can it actually reach?
The final index is a valid candidate too. Check the inner loop's stopping condition.
